record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.context_brief: Laguerre-Sobolev estimates with mass location cases
record.original_question: For Laguerre-Sobolev-type orthogonal polynomials on an unbounded support, use the classical estimates for Laguerre polynomials to derive estimates for the Sobolev-type polynomials, distinguishing the case where the mass is located at the boundary of the support from the case where the mass is located in the positive real half-line. Also derive estimates for the corresponding kernels using the Sobolev extension of the Christoffel-Darboux formula.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a parameter $\alpha>-1$, let $\{L_n^{(\alpha)}\}_{n\ge 0}$ denote the classical Laguerre orthogonal polynomials, orthogonal on $[0,\infty)$ with respect to the weight $d\mu_\alpha(x)=x^{\alpha}e^{-x}\,dx$. Fix $c\ge 0$, $\lambda\ge 0$, and $N\ge 0$, and consider the discrete Sobolev-type inner product
$$\langle f,g\rangle_S \;=\; \int_0^{\infty} f(x)\,g(x)\,x^{\alpha}e^{-x}\,dx \;+\; N\,f'(c)\,g'(c),$$
acting on real polynomials. Let $\{S_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ be the sequence of monic polynomials orthogonal with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$, and let
$$K_n^S(x,y)=\sum_{k=0}^n \frac{S_k(x)S_k(y)}{\langle S_k,S_k\rangle_S}$$
denote the corresponding reproducing (Christoffel–Darboux) kernels.

(a) Using the known asymptotic and pointwise estimates for the classical Laguerre polynomials $L_n^{(\alpha)}$ on $[0,\infty)$, derive sharp uniform and pointwise estimates for $S_n(x)$ on compact subsets of $[0,\infty)$ and on the oscillatory and Plancherel–Rotach regions, treating separately:
 (i) the boundary mass case $c=0$;
 (ii) the interior mass case $c>0$.

(b) Using a Sobolev-type extension of the Christoffel–Darboux formula adapted to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$, derive the corresponding estimates for the kernels $K_n^S(x,y)$ in both cases (i) and (ii).
artifact.status_search_result: No specific resolution of these Laguerre–Sobolev estimates with mass at the boundary versus in the interior was located. Several partial results exist in the literature on Laguerre–Sobolev-type polynomials (asymptotics, Mehler–Heine formulas), but a complete answer covering both mass-location regimes together with Christoffel–Darboux-type kernel bounds does not appear to be settled, so the status is taken as unknown.

status_evidence.snippet: Listed as an open problem (Problema 4) concerning Laguerre–Sobolev-type estimates.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem in a list of open problems on Sobolev-type Fourier series.
